This metric aggregates indicators of tree stress, including bark damage, branch damage, basal sprouts, and pest damage. Each stressor is scored from 0 to 2, where 0 indicates no issues, 1 indicates minor issues, and 2 indicates major issues. Scores for all four stressor categories are summed for each tree, then averaged across all trees in a block. The total is divided by the number of trees to produce a block-level average stressor score.

Tree health mean is the average proportion of canopy present across all surveyed trees. A value like 0.95 means that, on average, each tree retains 95% of its expected full canopy, indicating overall high canopy health.
